targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM gold.dim_customer WHERE dbt_valid_to IS NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM gold.dim_customer WHERE dbt_valid_to IS NULL AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
SELECT round(100.0*avg(CASE WHEN is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),1) AS pct_on_time FROM gold.fact_delivery_performance
SELECT round(avg(delay_days), 2) AS avg_delay_days FROM gold.fact_delivery_performance
SELECT date_trunc('$time_grain', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS new_customers FROM gold.dim_customer WHERE dbt_valid_to IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Process time stats (avg / p50 / p90, hours)

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(process_time_seconds)/3600.0 AS avg_hours, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY process_time_seconds)/3600.0 AS p50_hours, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY process_time_seconds)/3600.0 AS p90_hours FROM gold.fact_delivery_performance

SELECT fs.zone_city, sum(fs.line_amount) AS revenue FROM gold.fact_sales fs JOIN gold.dim_datetime d ON d.date_key = fs.order_date_key WHERE date_trunc('$time_grain', d.date) = date_trunc('$time_grain', now()) GROUP BY fs.zone_city ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT fs.category, sum(fs.line_amount) AS revenue FROM gold.fact_sales fs JOIN gold.dim_datetime d ON d.date_key = fs.order_date_key WHERE date_trunc('$time_grain', d.date) = date_trunc('$time_grain', now()) GROUP BY fs.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT dz.city, sum(fpo.line_amount) AS revenue FROM gold.fact_product_on_orders fpo JOIN gold.fact_purchase_orders fo ON fo.purchase_order_id = fpo.purchase_order_id JOIN gold.dim_delivery_zone dz ON dz.zone_id = fo.zone_id WHERE fpo.updated_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY dz.city ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT p.name, f.current_stock, f.nominal_capacity FROM gold.fact_inventory_snapshot f JOIN gold.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id AND p.dbt_valid_to IS NULL WHERE f.restock_required AND f.snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM gold.fact_inventory_snapshot)
